text:
marco: Quick heads-up  we deployed quant-kernel-swap + adaptive-batcher-v1 to hosted canary (20%) at 1912345678. Posting early perf numbers and the rollout plan. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: release marco/quant-kernel-swap+adaptive-batcher-v1 -> canary (20%) succeeded. details: https://internal.redwood/deploys/1912345678

marco: Canary vs baseline (same traffic slice): p50 latency -30% (70ms -> 49ms), p99 -18% (420ms -> 344ms), avg token cost per request -20%. GPU busy fraction down ~11%.

anya: 🔥 impressive. Any impact on quantized-model fidelity? ran evals?

marco: Good Q. This swap only changes the low-level kernel and the batching window heuristics; model weights unchanged. Ran full eval suite and a targeted MMLU/bias pass — no regressions. If you see anything, tag #eng-runtime.

raul: What about long-context routes? Any p99 surprises?

marco: Long-context (>1500 tokens) saw neutral p50 and a small p99 uptick (~4-6%) in a few routes due to batching alignment, but token cost improved. Adding a 5m long-context smoke to canary pipeline now.

zoe: Ops: what's the rollback key and operator command? Need to add to runbook and paging.

marco: Rollback flag: runtime.quant_kernel=false. Operator commands in the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/quant-kernel-swap. Quick toggle:

```
# immediate rollback
redwoodctl feature set runtime.quant_kernel=false --scope=hosted --selector=canary
```

infra: We'll watch GPU memory fragmentation and kernel fallback rates. Alerts updated for kernel-fallback >0.5% and p99 drift.

product: Will this affect Dedicated customers? Some teams pin clusters next week.

marco: Dedicated pools are excluded from the canary by default. We'll offer an opt-in test for reserved pools after we hit 50% hosted. Plan: stay at 20% for 24h, expand to 50% if p99 holds, then 100% over 48h. Opt-in form will be posted to the runbook.

eng-oncall: Please cc infra@ and product-sre@ before the 50% flip so oncall can watch closely.

marco: Will do. Big shoutout to the runtime team (Anya, Raul, Jin) for pushing the quant kernels and batcher tuning. We'll publish a short econ + regression writeup after 72h. :tada:
